name: no.apier/mcp
description: Norwegian company verification and signing authority (signaturrett, prokura) for AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: APIER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Apier API key (apr_<tier>_…) from https://www.apier.no/docs/authentication. Required for protected tool calls; discovery is keyless.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token built from your Apier API key (apr_<tier>_…) from https://www.apier.no/docs/authentication. Required for protected tool calls; discovery is keyless.
